The ressourcedirektør holds the economy, study services, buildings and infrastructure remit, i.e. the universitetsdirektør-equivalent. Email published on the direktion page. Alternative if a board chair is preferred: bestyrelsesformand Trine Ladekarl Nellemann, title 'Formand' (https://www.kp.dk/om-koebenhavns-professionshoejskole/bestyrelsen/).

instName: Royal Danish Academy of Music (Det Kgl. Danske Musikkonservatorium)
title: Bestyrelsesleder (Chair of the Board)
notes: Key-role scrape 2026-09-12 — fills the President / Exec Board seat. DKDM has no universitetsdirektør or administrativ direktør — leadership is rektor plus (from 2025) a prorektor — so per the brief the board chair was used. Kim Bohr (chef for DR Koncerthuset) has chaired the board since it was established in 2023 and is listed as bestyrelsesleder on the current governance page. No email published.

title: Rektor (Rector)
notes: Key-role scrape 2026-09-12 — fills the Rector seat. KEA (Københavns Erhvervsakademi) merged with Cphbusiness on 1 July 2025 to form Erhvervsakademi København (EK); kea.dk now redirects to ek.dk. Steen Enemark Kildesgaard, formerly rektor of KEA, is rektor of the merged institution; Ole Gram-Olesen (former Cphbusiness rektor) is prorektor. No email published for him; EK's published staff addresses (annw@ek.dk, amax@ek.dk) use inconsistent abbreviations, so no pattern could be confirmed.

title: Ressourcedirektør (Director of Resources)
notes: Key-role scrape 2026-09-12 — fills the President / Exec Board seat. EK's direktion is rektor + prorektor + two uddannelsesdirektører + ressourcedirektør + markedsdirektør; the ressourcedirektør is the top administrative leader (universitetsdirektør-equivalent). No email published and no confirmable address pattern. Alternative if a board chair is preferred: bestyrelsesformand Charlotte Lundblad, title 'Formand' (https://www.ek.dk/om-os/organisation).
